canonical_title: Identification of safety-critical functions and equipment
subject_group: 11.4.1 Air system diagnostics ability to detect and report critical failures

versions.title_at_revision: Identification of safety-critical functions and equipment
versions.text:
Standard: All SCFs supported by avionics and diagnostic equipment, and all safety-critical avionics and diagnostic equipment, are identified. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) An analysis (e.g., SCFTA) is performed to physically and functionally decompose each SCF to identify all SCFs which are supported by avionics and diagnostic equipment. All safety-critical avionics and diagnostic equipment are identified and documented.
